title: Decision Maker Arcade
intro: Sharpen your logic! Decide what's True, what's False, and how Python makes choices. First-try wins earn ⭐⭐⭐!

rounds.prompt: Which of these is a Boolean value?
rounds.explain: Booleans are special: they can only be True or False (no quotes!).
5 is greater than 3, so the condition is True and the message prints.

rounds.prompt: Why won't this run? Pick the fix.
rounds.explain: An if statement always needs a colon ( : ) at the end of its line.

rounds.prompt: What is the result of:  True and False ?
rounds.explain: 'and' is only True when BOTH sides are True. One False makes the whole thing False.
10 is not >= 13, so Python jumps to the else branch and prints Kid.

rounds.prompt: Build a check: if it's raining, take an umbrella, otherwise wear sunglasses.
rounds.explain: The if comes first, then its action, then else with its own action.
